verdict.rationale: Paychex's own payroll page says it handles direct deposits for your team in one click, so founders can pay employees by direct deposit instead of checks. Nothing in the evidence documents the 'fast' part of the story: no next-day or 2-day deposit timing or funding deadlines. The only speed claim ('fast, accurate payments') applies to independent contractors and gives no timing. missing for 10: documented next-day or 2-day direct deposit for employees, funding cutoff details, independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed.
